-- test.html --
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Old Title</title><meta name="description" content="Old Description"></head><body>Hello</body></html>

-- stdin.html --
<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><title>Stdin Title</title></head><body></body></html>

-- commands --
# Test setting title
exec header edit head test.html -s 'New Title'
exec cat test.html
stdout '<title>New Title</title>'

# Test setting meta
exec header edit meta description test.html -s 'New Description'
exec cat test.html
stdout 'content="New Description"'

# Test setting og:title which uses property= instead of name=
exec header edit meta og:title test.html -s 'OG Title'
exec cat test.html
stdout 'property="og:title" content="OG Title"'

# Test add
exec header edit meta keywords test.html -S 'keyword1, keyword2'
exec cat test.html
stdout 'name="keywords" content="keyword1, keyword2"'

# Test replace
exec header edit meta description test.html -r 'Replaced Description'
exec cat test.html
stdout 'content="Replaced Description"'

# Test stdin/stdout
stdin stdin.html
exec header edit head - -s 'Replaced Stdin Title'
stdout '<title>Replaced Stdin Title</title>'
